STEP 1 - Scene: A lunch/dinner tray meal (hospital or cafeteria style, tray number 3004) photographed from a fairly high, near-overhead angle.

STEP 2 - Ruler: The large cabbage-slaw plate is a paper plate about 22 cm in diameter, area ≈ 3.14 × (11)² ≈ 380 cm². The sushi plate is about 20 cm (≈314 cm²). The fruit bowl is about 15 cm (≈177 cm²).

STEP 3 - Items:
- Coleslaw/chicken salad (shredded cabbage, carrot, shredded chicken, light dressing)
- Sushi rolls, 5 small maki pieces (salmon, cucumber, cream cheese, rice, nori)
- Mixed fruit bowl (strawberries, watermelon, grapes, blueberries)
- Orange juice (about 200 ml glass)
- Soy sauce (small cup, ~15 ml), pickled ginger (~20 g)

STEP 4 - Area (of the vessel it covers):
- Coleslaw: ~60% of 380 cm² ≈ 230 cm², average height 2.5 cm → 575 ml × 0.4 (mixed salad, airy) ≈ 230 g. Chicken shreds and dressing are included.
- Sushi: 5 pieces covering ~45% of 314 cm² ≈ 140 cm², height ~3 cm (roll diameter ~2.5 cm, each piece ~2.5 cm across) → ~420 ml × 0.9 ≈ 110 g... but each roll is ~2.5 cm diameter and ~3 cm long, about 15–18 g each; 5 pieces ≈ 85 g total.
- Fruit: ~85% of 177 cm² ≈ 150 cm², height 3 cm → 450 ml × 0.6 ≈ 270 g, but the bowl is shallow, so ~180 g.
- Orange juice: 200 ml × 1.0 ≈ 200 g.
- Soy sauce: ~15 g.
- Pickled ginger: ~20 g.

STEP 5–6 - Grams, as above (coleslaw ~230 g, sushi ~85 g, fruit ~180 g, juice ~200 g, soy sauce ~15 g, ginger ~20 g).

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Coleslaw with chicken and light dressing: ~70 kcal/100 g → 230 g ≈ 161 kcal
- Sushi (rice, salmon, cream cheese): ~170 kcal/100 g → 85 g ≈ 145 kcal
- Mixed fruit: ~50 kcal/100 g → 180 g ≈ 90 kcal
- Orange juice: ~45 kcal/100 g → 200 g ≈ 90 kcal
- Soy sauce: ~55 kcal/100 g → 15 g ≈ 8 kcal
- Pickled ginger: ~30 kcal/100 g → 20 g ≈ 6 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total ≈ 730 g and ≈ 500 kcal. This is plausible for a full tray of this composition, with the salad and juice as the largest components.
